Bootstrap uncertainty of preprocessing and parameters

Source: R/model-bootstrap.R
bootstrapped.Rd

Wraps a model so that its forecast draws include the uncertainty of the estimated parameters and, optionally, of the preprocessing (smoothing, ungrouping). The model is refitted on n_boot resampled datasets and the forecast draws are pooled across refits:

Usage

bootstrapped(spec, n_boot = 50, type = c("grid", "data"), seed = 1)

Arguments

spec

A model specification.

n_boot

Number of bootstrap refits.

type

"grid" or "data".

seed

Random seed for the resampling.

Value

A model specification.

Details

  • type = "grid": deaths on the grid (after preprocessing) are drawn from Poisson distributions with the fitted rates of the model (or the preprocessed rates when the model has no fitted rates); the model is refitted without preprocessing. This is the semi-parametric bootstrap of Brouhns et al. (2005), generalised to any model.

  • type = "data": the observed deaths, at their original resolution, are drawn from Poisson distributions with the observed counts as means, and preprocessing and model are refitted. This propagates the uncertainty of ungrouping and smoothing, for any smoother.

References

Brouhns N, Denuit M, Van Keilegom I (2005). Bootstrapping the Poisson log-bilinear model for mortality forecasting. Scandinavian Actuarial Journal 2005(3): 212-224.

Examples

x <- mt_example(deaths = "single", years = 2000:2019)
fit <- mt_fit(bootstrapped(rwd(), n_boot = 5), x)
fc <- mt_forecast(fit, h = 3, n_draws = 50, seed = 1)
